chapter: Leading his own band in New York
title: Kirby's band at the Onyx Club next door
summary: The loud John Kirby sextet next door and its members.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. That's how John Kirby got his style. I was at the Famous Door next door and at that time John Kirby had five pieces and five of the loudest guys you ever heard in your life.
He had Pete Brown on saxophone-- And Frankie Newton.
Don Frye playing piano. And Leo Watson was working with him?
I don't think Leo was in the band.
What did Leo play? He played drums.
No, we had another guy; he died later.
They were just a jamming band.
Well actually it wasn't really Kirby's band; it was more Frankie Newton's band, wasn't it?
No, that was Kirby's band. It was John Kirby's band.
